candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, causing POST /v1/reservations 503 and upstream order/gateway 502s across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; gateway dependency metric series empty. Redis fault inferred from client spans only.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests fail with 502 after ~2s; traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory propagating to order and gateway. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Redis-side telemetry is absent, so the bounded candidate is redis-timeout with residual uncertainty.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs confirming timeout or saturation on reserve_inventory
Inventory service logs correlating the redis timeout to the 503 responses
